understanding.goal_understanding: The goal was to progress through every level by moving each selectable piece onto a goal tile marked '+', with all goals occupied simultaneously to trigger a win.
understanding.mechanics_understanding: Pieces move one grid cell per directional action, while walls block movement and pushable blocks can be shifted when adjacent. Multiple selectable pieces can be controlled by CLICKing their exact pixel/grid coordinates; switching selection is necessary to position every piece on its corresponding goal.
